tasks.prompt: You are the president of your university's book club. The club has decided to read a classic novel for the next meeting. One member, Maria, emailed you to ask if the club can read another book instead. She wrote that she finds the novel too difficult for her to read.
bullets: ● Explain why you cannot switch to another book.
● Suggest some online resources that may help her with the novel.
tasks.subject: Our next book

tasks.instruction:
In your response, you should do the following.
   ●  Express and support your opinion.
   ●  Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Achebe
professor.text: As technology continues to evolve, educators are faced with the challenge of integrating new tools into their teaching practices. While some see these innovations as opportunities to enhance learning and engagement, others are concerned about potential classroom distractions caused by the use of technology and the impact on instructional quality. In what ways can technology be used thoughtfully to support, rather than detract from, the educational experience?

posts.name: Paul
posts.text: Integrating technology into education is essential for preparing students for a digital world. Tools like interactive apps, online resources, and virtual labs make learning more engaging and accessible to students who might otherwise have been disengaged with traditional teaching methods. When used thoughtfully, technology helps educators connect with students in ways that traditional methods would not.

posts.name: Kelly
posts.text: While technology can be helpful, it too often becomes a distraction in the classroom. Constant notifications and reliance on digital tools can reduce a student's ability to concentrate or think critically and independently. Sometimes, traditional teaching methods offer a structured learning experience that technology can unintentionally disrupt.
